def adjacent_elements_product(arr):
    max_product = arr[0] * arr[1]
    for i in range(1, len(arr) - 1):
        product = arr[i] * arr[i + 1]
        if product > max_product:
            max_product = product
    return max_product
```

The loop `for i in range(1, len(arr) - 1)` iterates from index 1 to `len(arr) - 2`.
This means it checks pairs `(arr[1], arr[2])`, `(arr[2], arr[3])`, ..., `(arr[len(arr)-2], arr[len(arr)-1])`.

The loop starts checking from `i=1`, which corresponds to the pair `(arr[1], arr[2])`.

So for `i=1`, `product = arr[1] * arr[2]`.
For `i=len(arr)-2`, `product = arr[len(arr)-2] * arr[len(arr)-1]`.

...
